opendb_id.description: Unique identifier for the document (UUID v4)

weight.description: Product weight in grams for one complete, usable unit of this exact variant. Exclude retail packaging, shipping materials, multipack totals, and load capacity. Leave unset when the product is digital, the weight is unknown, or the source does not clearly identify product weight.

chipset_manufacturer.description: Manufacturer of the GPU chipset (e.g., NVIDIA, AMD, Intel)

chipset.description: The specific GPU chipset (e.g., GeForce RTX 4090, Radeon RX 7900 XTX, ARC B580)

core_count.description: Number of cores/shaders in the GPU

core_base_clock.description: The base clock speed of the GPU core in MHz

core_boost_clock.description: The boost clock speed of the GPU core in MHz

memory.description: The amount of video memory in GB

memory_type.description: The type of video memory (e.g., GDDR6X, GDDR6)

tdp.description: The Thermal Design Power of the graphics card in Watts

interface.description: The interface used by the graphics card (e.g., PCIe 4.0 x16, PCIe 5.0 x16)

frame_sync.description: The frame synchronization technology supported (e.g., G-Sync, FreeSync, None)

color.description: The color(s) of this product. Each color of the product should be included in the array. Do not use RGB here to describe lighting; use the Lighting field for RGB, ARGB, display, or fixed-color lighting. Includes shroud and backplate colors

lighting.description: Lighting capabilities for this product. Use RGB for non-addressable RGB, ARGB for addressable RGB, Multicolor for non-RGB multi-color lighting, Fixed for a single fixed lighting color, None when the product has no lighting, Display for configurable displays, and Fixed Color Display for displays limited to fixed colors such as black and white.

length.description: The length of the graphics card in mm

case_expansion_slot_width.description: The number of case expansion slot widths the card occupies

total_slot_width.description: The total slot width the card occupies, accounting for cooler size

cooling.description: The type of cooling solution (e.g., 3 Fans, 2 Fans, Blower, Water Cooled)

radiator_size.description: External radiator size in mm (for example 120, 240, or 360) Populate this only for liquid or hybrid GPUs that include an external radiator.

fan_size.description: Size of the included external-radiator fan(s) in mm (for example 120 or 140)

fan_quantity.description: Number of fans included with the external GPU radiator

pcie_8_pin.description: Number of 8-pin PCIe connectors (150W each). A 16-pin PCIe connector is 2x 8-pin PCIe connectors.

video_outputs.description: Legacy GPU output counts retained for migration. Use Display Outputs for newly verified port information.

display_outputs.description: Confirmed video output groups that send video from this exact source product to an external display. Do not enter input-only ports, ordinary USB data ports, or raw legacy connector text. Legacy video-port counts are migration candidates, not automatic evidence.

items.description: One group of physically identical video-capable ports on the exact product configuration.

id.description: Stable system-generated row identifier. It is assigned on save and is not entered by reviewers.

connector.description: Physical connector type for this group of otherwise identical video-capable ports.

count.description: Number of identical ports in this group; omit when the official count is unknown.

version_label.description: Manufacturer's exact connector or protocol version label. A version label alone never proves a display mode.

video_signal.description: Confirmed video signal carried by this port group. It must be known before the group is used for compatibility.

transport.description: Published native, DisplayPort Alt Mode, Thunderbolt, or USB4 transport for this group.

connector_label.description: Manufacturer's connector name; required when connector is other.

graphics_route.description: Published discrete, integrated, or switchable graphics route for an output group; omit rather than guessing.

mode_claims.description: Official resolution-and-refresh claims for this exact port group. Leave unset when unknown; do not infer modes from connector version.

items.description: One sourced resolution-and-refresh claim for the containing port group.

id.description: Stable system-generated row identifier. It is assigned on save and is not entered by reviewers.

resolution.description: Exact resolution carried by this port for this individual sourced claim.

horizontalRes.description: Horizontal pixel count for this exact resolution claim; must be a positive integer.

verticalRes.description: Vertical pixel count for this exact resolution claim; must be a positive integer.

refresh_rate.description: Positive refresh rate in Hz for this exact port-and-resolution claim.

claim.description: Use supported for a listed timing. Use maximum_at_resolution only when an official source states the ceiling.

dsc.description: Whether DSC is explicitly required or explicitly not required for this exact claim.

hdr.description: Explicit HDR support condition for this exact claim.

conditions.description: Unusual official restrictions for this exact claim. Preserve as source context; do not parse as a compatibility rule.

general_product_information.description: General product information and retailer SKUs

manufacturer.description: GPU manufacturer Use the board partner / card manufacturer, not the chipset designer unless they are the same. Examples: ASUS, MSI, EVGA, Gigabyte, Zotac, Sapphire, XFX, PowerColor.

series.description: Product series name The manufacturer's sub-brand or product line that groups related cards. Manufacturer and chipset are stored separately and combined automatically, so do NOT repeat them here. Examples: 'ASUS ROG Astral OC GeForce RTX 5090' → series='ROG Astral'. 'MSI Gaming X Trio GeForce RTX 4090' → series='Gaming X Trio'. 'Sapphire Nitro+ Radeon RX 7900 XTX Vapor-X' → series='Nitro+'. Do NOT include OC/variant suffixes, memory size, or color in the series.

variant.description: Specific variant in the series The SKU-level differentiator inside a (manufacturer, chipset, series) group. It is almost always a clock tier or model line suffix (`OC`, `OC Edition`, `Vapor-X`, `FTW3`). It is NOT the color and NOT the named edition (those go in `manufacturer_color`). Examples: 'Asus ROG Astral OC GeForce RTX 5080 16GB' → variant='OC'. 'Asus ROG Astral OC HATSUNE MIKU EDITION GeForce RTX 5080' → variant='OC' with manufacturer_color='HATSUNE MIKU Edition'. 'MSI Gaming X Trio GeForce RTX 4090' (base) → variant=''. The variant must be unique within a (manufacturer, chipset, series, manufacturer_color) group — if two cards collapse to the same variant AND the same manufacturer_color, you are missing a differentiator.

manufacturer_color.description: Manufacturer's official color name for this product variant. The manufacturer's marketed colorway / finish name, verbatim. Common values: 'Black', 'Black / Silver', 'White'. Multi-tone cards use ' / ' (e.g., 'Black / Silver'). Branded special / collab editions belong here when the rest of the SKU is identical to a same-tier card (e.g., 'HATSUNE MIKU Edition', 'Noctua Edition'). Most stock cards are 'Black'. Do NOT put clock-tier or SKU descriptors like 'OC', 'OC Edition', 'FTW3', 'Vapor-X' in manufacturer_color — those belong in the variant.

last_manually_spec_verified_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the part specs were last manually verified by a human

retailer_listings.description: Canonical retailer product listings used for pricing

identifiers.description: Current versioned product identity snapshot used for retailer and pricing matching
